item.title: My First Modular Patch
item.description:
My First Modular Patch

This is my first exploration into modular synthesis! I’m starting with some basic modules and learning how to create interesting sounds through patching.

What I’m Using

  • Oscillator: For generating the basic sound wave
  • Filter: To shape the timbre of the sound
  • Envelope Generator: To control how the sound evolves over time
  • VCA: To control the volume

The Patch

The basic signal flow I’m exploring:

  1. Oscillator generates a sawtooth wave
  2. Filter shapes the sound (low-pass filter)
  3. Envelope controls the filter cutoff
  4. VCA controls the final volume

What I Learned

Modular synthesis is all about experimentation and understanding signal flow. Even simple patches can create complex and interesting sounds when you understand how the modules interact.
